patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: IRDP start year (1980), NREP/RLEGP in 6th Plan, SGSY launched April 1999 and now 'Aajeevika', NRLM borrowers = women SHGs.
Strong AP tilt: SAPAP supported by UNDP, IKP full form and merger role, Velugu, MEPMA as urban poverty mission, Abhaya Hastham for SHG women, Janmabhoomi 1997.
DAY-NULM asked as ministry (Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation) and current-affairs tie-ups (UNDP-DAY-NULM for women, 2023).
Other PSCs favour chronology ordering (IRDP-NREP-DWCRA-JRY; IRDP-SGSY-NREGA-PMJDY), odd-one-out (MRTP, NSSF, CRY) and programmes merged into SGSY (JRY not included).
App MCQs add current DAY-NRLM data (Lakhpati Didi, CLF counts, funding ratios) and multi-statement items beyond the PYQ depth; PYQs stay at name/year/agency level.
